notes: Total matching image/video files found across the library: ~674, past the 600-file stop condition in the brief. Enumeration was halted (no further subfolder recursion) once this was clear; unread folders: 'Warehouse Content 7/9/26/Video 6 - B Roll edit' (empty), 'Professional Product Photos/MINI 2026 Photos/installation pics', 'Professional Product Photos/Matterhorn Photos 2026/installation', 'Professional Product Photos/Rainier 2026 Photos/PEAK-RAINIER', 'Professional Product Photos/Kilimanjaro 2026 Photos/PEAK-KILIMANJARO', 'Professional Product Photos/Patagonia 2026 Photos/PEAK-PATAGONIA', 'Professional Product Photos/Fuji 2026 Photos/PEAK-FUJI', 'Professional Product Photos/Everest 2026 Photos/PEAK-EVEREST', 'Professional Product Photos/Shasta 2026 Photos/PEAK-SHASTA', 'Professional Product Photos/El Capitan 2025/2025 Model'. 'Peak Manuals/CAD Drawings' was checked and contains only PDFs (no images). Six large, visually-uniform galleries of near-duplicate professional stills (each already model- and kind-tagged from its folder, so a renderer can select the folder rather than a single frame) are represented as a single aggregate row each, with id:null and a count field, instead of one row per photo: MINI 2026 Photos (58), Matterhorn Photos 2026 (72), Rainier 2025 (87), Shasta 2025 (78), Fuji 2025 (91), Warehouse Content/Stock Images (59) = 445 files not itemized individually. All other 229 matching files (logos, the Kilimanjaro photo-shoot lifestyle set, all customer/UGC photos, review screenshots, and every warehouse video incl. B-Roll and the 'Final Ad Edit' clips) are itemized individually below with exact Drive file IDs. No Crown/Olympus/Aspen image or video assets were found anywhere in the library (those discontinued models only appear as PDF manuals, which are out of scope), so no rows are marked excluded:true.
